d: Shizuka confronts Gonzou alone in a warehouse, Gonzou enraged attacks Shizuka only to end up tripping and banging heads with her resulting in an unexpected swap, after some exploration and realisation, zombies break into the warehouse, with his new fit and athletic body Gonzou is able to escape no problem, Shizuka however not used to their new large overweight body ends up being overrun and bitten by the horde, now free to do as he pleases Gonzou heads off to make the most of his new form.
